q: Which new network features were introduced in FortiOS 8.0.0? Give at least five.
kp: TCP congestion control enhancement with BBR
graceful BGP shutdown
BGP neighbor naming support
GPON support for FortiGates with SFP/SFP+ ports
IPv6 PCP support for DNAT46 in NAT64 deployments
enhanced EVPN support for VXLAN anycast gateway and type-5 routing
enhanced PIM support for IPv6 across all VRFs
increased AS path item count for BGP route maps

q: According to the FortiOS 8.0.2 Release Notes, what is the release date of the initial 8.0.2 build, which FortiGate models are covered, and what must a VM do before upgrading directly to 8.0.2?
kp: initial release 2026-10-22, build 0251
a VM must first upgrade to 8.0.1 (CMS signature support starts at 8.0.1) before 8.0.2

q: How does FortiOS 8.0.2 support graceful (uninterruptible) firmware upgrade in a FortiGate 7000F FGCP HA cluster?
kp: config system ha set upgrade-mode uninterruptible (the default)
session-pickup must be enabled (set session-pickup enable)
the 7000F session-sync-dev uses a LAG combining M1 of FIM slot 1 and M1 of FIM slot 2

q: List the default service ports defined for FortiOS 8.0.0 for the FGFM tunnel (IPv4 and IPv6), FortiToken Cloud, NetFlow, sFlow, and HA status synchronization.
kp: FGFM tunnel: TCP 541 for IPv4, TCP 542 for IPv6
FortiToken Cloud: TCP 8686
NetFlow: UDP 2055
sFlow: UDP 6343
HA status synchronization: TCP 703

q: What hardware acceleration features were added in FortiOS 8.0.1 for NP7 processors? Name at least three.
kp: NP7 link scan interval configurable (config system npu set np-linkscan-interval, 50-1000 ms, default 1000 ms) to reduce FGCP HA failover delays
NP7 and NP7Lite can offload IPsec sessions over a VNE interface
SCTP traffic can pass through virtual switches on NP7Lite (SOC5) or NP6XLite (SOC4)
mcs-auto-start enable on NP7 to auto-flush/reinstall IPsec SAs after egress shaping profile changes
VLAN accounting on/off with configurable interval (vlan-accounting, vlan-acct-interval)
emac-vlan-mode {functionality | offloading} on NP6/NP6XLite

q: What new NP7 (SOC5) capabilities were introduced in FortiOS 8.0.0? Name at least four.
kp: L3/L4 header-based hashing for NP7-offloaded GRE tunnels
ECMP hashing of NP7-offloaded GRE tunnels
NP7 offloading of TCP/UDP sessions denied by firewall policy (CPU usage reduction)
NP7 VXLAN MAC flapping protection
fp-anomaly checksum error handling gains an allow option (tcp-csum-err/udp-csum-err/icmp-csum-err {allow|drop|trap-to-host})
session accounting interval range now 1-600 seconds (session-acct-interval)
sw-np-rate controls bandwidth between NP7 and the internal switch fabric (ISF)
dynamic shaping profiles based on RADIUS VSAs for NP7/NP7Lite-offloaded traffic
vlan-lookup-cache default changed to disable

q: Describe the FortiGate 7121F chassis architecture and how FIMs and FPMs are slotted, and what FGCP HA capability was added for 7000F in FortiOS 8.0.1.
kp: 7121F is a 16U 19-inch rackmount 12-slot chassis with a 1Tbps fabric backplane (50Gbps base backplane)
FIMs always install in slots 1 and 2; FPMs fill slots 3-12
7081F chassis takes two FIMs and two to ten FPMs
FortiOS 8.0.1 adds FGCP HA support between an AC-powered and a DC-powered 7000F chassis
8.0.1 adds high memory utilization failover protection for 7000F FGCP HA

q: What are the capabilities of the CP10 content processor compared with the CP9, and which CP9 features were moved off the CP10?
kp: CP10 delivers 20 Gbps IPSA throughput, double the CP9
CP10 supports a rule database six times larger than the CP9
CP10 accelerates DLP fingerprint inspection
CP10 removes ECC, PKCE, and VPN features (handled more efficiently by other hardware components on the CP9)

q: What new FortiOS Carrier features were introduced in 8.0.0 and 8.0.1? Include the FGSP selective sync options, the GTP tunnel limit change, and what 8.0.1 adds for GTP-U.
kp: 8.0.0: FGSP can selectively synchronize only S10 GTP tunnels
8.0.0: FGSP can disable IP session sync and synchronize only GTP tunnels
8.0.0: 3G to 4G/5G handover support
8.0.0: twelve new RAT types from 3GPP TS 29.274 Release 17 (e.g. WB-E-UTRAN/LTE-M satellite variants LEO/MEO/GEO/OTHERSAT, EUTRAN-NB-IoT)
8.0.0: GTP tunnel limit increased from 16,000,000 to 50,000,000
8.0.1: IPS engine can inspect GTP-U payloads to analyze UE traffic in GTPv2 sessions
8.0.1: IPv6 support for GTP-U with dynamic source ports on NP7 systems

q: How is FortiOS Carrier licensed and on which platforms does FortiOS Carrier 8.0.2 run?
kp: runs on FortiGate 3000, 4000, 5000, and 7000 series plus FortiGate 2600F and 2601F
runs on VM08/VM08-v, VM16/VM16-v, VM32/VM32-v, VMUL/VMUL-v (not VM S-Series)
licensed with execute forticarrier-license <license-key>
licensing restarts the device and sets it to FortiOS Carrier factory default configuration
no re-licensing required after installing new FortiOS firmware

q: In the FortiOS 8.0.0 FortiGate MIB information overview, what is Fortinet's enterprise OID, the fnCoreMib base OID, and the OIDs for the fnSysSerial and fnAdminNumber objects?
kp: Fortinet enterprise OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.12356
fnCoreMib base OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.12356.100
fnSysSerial OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.12356.100.1.1.1 (device serial number, same as ENTITY-MIB base entity)
fnAdminNumber OID 1.3.6.1.4.1.12356.100.1.2.100.1 (number of admin accounts in fnAdminTable)

q: What command families are available for manual cellular modem firmware upgrades in the FortiOS 8.0.0 Modem Firmware Upgrade guide, and how do you schedule automatic upgrades from FortiGuard?
kp: execute cellular-modem firmware-upgrade ftp [ImageFile] [FTP Server]:Port (username) (password)
execute cellular-modem firmware-upgrade tftp [ImageFile] [TFTP Server]
execute cellular-modem firmware-upgrade usb [ImageFile]
execute cellular-modem firmware-upgrade management-station
set modem-upgrade-time "YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS" schedules the upgrade window
set modem-upgrade-frequency (e.g. everyHour, everyDay) sets how often the check runs
